target.purpose: Prevent notebook outputs from becoming stronger artifact claims unless exact notebook lineage, policy-specific evaluation evidence, and distinct owner quorum all bind the same artifact.
target.central_bottleneck: String-labelled evaluation and owner approval can be detached from notebook source, artifact content, policy requirements, and unique approving identities while still looking like a completed promotion.

invariants: strict promotion requires exact notebook source lineage rather than legacy unbound recording
cell identity cannot be rebound to different source or payload content
evaluation receipts bind exact artifact digest and promotion policy identity
the union of evaluation checks must satisfy the policy-specific required checks
owner approvals bind exact artifact digest and policy identity
owner quorum counts distinct owner IDs rather than approval rows
promotion proof content-addresses lineage, policy, evaluations, and distinct owner approvals
exact promotion replay is idempotent and different proof cannot rebind a completed promotion
production claims require a PRODUCTION-tier policy
nonclaims: not a production notebook governance service
notebook source SHA is caller-supplied rather than externally attested
owner and evaluator identities are not cryptographically authenticated
